title: Routing
hint: How sessions pick a model and effort for the work they hand to sub-agents and workers. New sessions read a short routing policy; the app records each choice and how it ended.

switches.policy: Use the routing policy in new sessions
switches.policyHint: New Claude sessions get the current policy in their system prompt and set a model and effort for each task kind. Sessions already open keep what they started with.
switches.escalation: Retry a failed worker once on a stronger model
switches.escalationHint: When a worker ends with a failed check, the app runs it once more one tier up before waking its session. Never more than once per task.
switches.autoUpdateHint: At most once a day, the app moves a task kind one step up or down from the recorded results, for new sessions only. Off: changes are shown here as a proposal.

report.title: Routing report
report.hint: Delegated work per task kind and tier. Success counts finished runs with a clear result: a worker's check passed, or a sub-agent completed and was not retried.
report.empty: No delegated work recorded in this period.
report.adoption: Agent calls in sessions with a policy: {calls}. With a model: {model} · with an effort: {effort} · with both: {both}.
